security_invariants: The release catalog remains declarative and contains no command fields.
This policy is a separate signed artifact verified against a pinned public key.
No operation may invoke a shell, command string, eval, exec, os.system, or shell=True.
Executables and scripts must resolve beneath trusted versioned app roots.
Arguments are constructed only from fixed values and JSON-Schema-validated typed parameters.
Environment inheritance is deny-by-default; only explicit variables and secret handles are injected.
Secret values never enter UI payloads, receipts, or persisted logs.
Writes outside declared managed scopes fail the operation and trigger rollback.
Only manager-signed validator receipts may satisfy readiness gates.
